sources.notes: LOLA polar DEM (Barker et al. ~512 ppd / ~60 m); polar same-frame lane.

sources.name: Moon LRO LOLA DEM 118 m (global)
sources.notes: Smith et al. 2010. Equirectangular global -> needs non-polar reprojection (TW-02) + windowed/tiled access (TW-03) for product paths.

sources.citation: USGS Astrogeology LRO NAC photoclinometry (Shape-from-Shading) DEM 1 m; method Alexandrov & Beyer 2018 (Earth & Space Sci. 5:652)
sources.name: LRO NAC Photoclinometry (SfS) DEM 1 m
sources.notes: Absolutely controlled (registered to the global geodetic frame). High-res local detail above the coarse polar backbone -- register to the global frame on import. Method is photoclinometry / Shape-from-Shading (Alexandrov & Beyer 2018), NOT LOLA altimetry.

sources.citation: USGS Astrogeology LRO NAC photoclinometry (Shape-from-Shading) DEM 1 m; method Alexandrov & Beyer 2018 (Earth & Space Sci. 5:652)
sources.name: Haworth SfS 2 km drive-site tile (1 m)
sources.notes: Real LRO NAC Shape-from-Shading (photoclinometry) 1 m DEM; a 2 km @ 1 m crop taken INSIDE the SfS footprint (Haworth) by scripts/build_from_dem.py --source-id lroc_nac_sfs_1m, imported 2026-07-10. The driveable viz2 work-site base (SfS method Alexandrov & Beyer 2018) -- NOT a LOLA Product-78 tile. See stewie.specs.sites.
